    In logs such as https://treeherder.mozilla.org/logviewer?job_id=551952962&repo=comm-central&task=OkCHo3bZRceflmE0Eu6EHA.0&lineNumber=4619
    it seems the alert eventually came. Only 17s after, and we only waited 5s.

diff --git a/mail/base/test/browser/getMessages/browser_getMessages_connectionError.js b/mail/base/test/browser/getMessages/browser_getMessages_connectionError.js
index 21783a13246..f784e8cdbca 100644

+++ b/mail/base/test/browser/getMessages/browser_getMessages_connectionError.js
@@ -153,10 +153,8 @@ add_task(async function testConnectionRefused() {
     );
     await BrowserTestUtils.waitForPopupEvent(getMessagesContext, "hidden");
 
-    const alert = await TestUtils.waitForCondition(
-      () => MockAlertsService.alert,
-      "waiting for connection alert to show"
-    );
+    await MockAlertsService.promiseShown();
+    const alert = MockAlertsService.alert;
 
     Assert.equal(
       alert.imageURL,
